title: Cosmic Industrial Muse
description: A surreal portrait of a pale woman with closed eyes, her head dissolving into a cosmic nebula filled with stars and galaxies while green leafy vines grow across her face and neck. In the background, a dystopian industrial complex with smoking factory chimneys rises from cracked earth under a starry purple sky, with floating chains and inscribed words like 'chain', 'scroll', and 'stay'.
